description: This file contains a comprehensive list of module and task-wise APIs that have been integrated in the admin panel. The APIs are organized by functional modules (Categories, Products, Inventory, Orders, Customers, Banners, FAQ, and Global Settings) with detailed information about endpoints, HTTP methods, and descriptions. For complete API documentation including request/response schemas, authentication details, and all available server endpoints, please refer to the swagger openapi.json file.

apis.name: Create Category

apis.name: List Categories
apis.description: Get all categories with product count.

apis.name: Get Category Details

apis.description: Update an existing category by ID.
